text: Seven runtimes, seven discovery contracts, all keyed to the runtime's own directory name: opencode (.opencode/skills,commands,agents,plugins), Claude (.claude/skills link + commands + real agents fork + settings.json hooks), Codex (no skills; .codex/prompts + .codex/agents generated; hooks outbound), Cursor (.cursor/commands,agents,rules,hooks.json; no skills surface), Devin (native .opencode/skills scan + .devin/agents nested + hooks.v1.json), Pi (.pi/skills link, prompts, extensions native; .pi/agents unconsumed), Hermes (.hermes/skills copies, prompts stubs, agents link, plugins opt-in). No repo-visible config key relocates any of them; manifests record probes where documented alternatives failed.

Seven MCP registrations carry the same relative .opencode/bin/mcp-code-mode-launcher.cjs string (opencode.json:15, .codex/config.toml:13, .pi/mcp.json:5, .devin/mcp_config.json:6, .cursor/mcp.json:6, .claude/mcp.json:6, ~/.hermes/config.yaml:17). The launcher computes repo root from its own location then appends the literal string .opencode/skills/mcp-code-mode/mcp-server and requires dist/index.js (a build artifact). A symlink at .opencode satisfies all seven; deleting .opencode breaks all seven including the home-level Hermes one.

opencode's five reads are all inside .opencode/ (skills, commands, agents, plugins flat glob, MCP). Nothing is relocatable by config. UNKNOWN whether opencode's plugin flat glob follows a symlinked .opencode directory; a scratch-project probe would settle it.

Generated runtime files carry literal .opencode instructions the runtime executes: .codex/prompts/*.md and .pi/prompts/*.md tell the model to read .opencode/commands/<path>.md in full; .codex/agents/*.toml embed .opencode paths in prompt bodies. Text rewrite is wrong (generator overwrites); repoint generator then regenerate.

Devin has two skill surfaces: documented native .opencode/skills scan (no mirror) and observed resolution through .claude/skills link in this live session. UNKNOWN whether native scan traverses a symlinked .opencode. Devin has no .devin/skills fallback.

~/.hermes/config.yaml: trusted_project_dirs = main checkout root (survives); mcp_servers.code_mode carries relative .opencode/bin/mcp-code-mode-launcher.cjs (breaks if .opencode deleted). Hermes gates writes whose parent is .hermes, so generated copies are authored outside a Hermes session.

Codex hooks are installed outbound: ~/.codex/hooks.json (outside repo) holds 18 .opencode/... command strings, reconciled from repo .codex/hooks.json by install-codex-hooks.mjs. Ordering: rewrite repo-side first, then re-run installer.

Contradiction: cli-codex/README.md:131 claims .codex/config.toml declares [agents.<name>] entries with config_file -> .codex/agents/<name>.toml; neither in-repo nor home config.toml contains any [agents.*] or config_file key (grep count 0). UNKNOWN what wires the 12 TOML agents; a dispatch probe or Codex docs would settle it.

Pi's generated .pi/agents tree has no installed consumer today (no agent flag; the community package is gone); .pi/prompts and .pi/extensions are live. Priority: extensions/prompts first, agents last.

noveltyJustification: First consolidated seven-runtime contract table; launcher literal-string finding, runtime-consumed generated stubs, Codex [agents.*] contradiction, home-level Hermes/MCP registrations all new; limited re-citation of SYNC.md mechanism columns from iteration 1.
